mechanisms.statement: DWARF function/type/local/lexical-scope/location evidence constrains source reconstruction and can distinguish scope/lifetime issues from absent code.
mechanisms.symptom: A candidate has stack/register residue or an apparent missing-local/source-scope discrepancy.
mechanisms.discriminating_experiment: Compare original and candidate locations/lexical ranges at the first decoded mismatch; make only a scope-constrained overlay when a declaration fact is independently evidenced.
mechanisms.negative_alternatives: Absent/overlapping/unsupported location expression is unknown, not an optimized-out-local conclusion.
mechanisms.scope: Icy Tower DWARF-rich Win32/GCC context; unsupported or overlapping location expressions remain unknown.
mechanisms.diagnostic: Compare original/candidate DWARF locations and lexical scope at the first decoded mismatch.

mechanisms.statement: Original DWARF declaration order restored scroller natural offsets while target register mismatch remained unresolved.
mechanisms.symptom: Function extents/order differ despite retained body source, or a source-order task is proposed from executable address order.
mechanisms.discriminating_experiment: Build a no-body-change full-CU overlay in unique DWARF definition order and compare target, full contribution, and exact neighbors.
mechanisms.negative_alternatives: Historical order did not repair draw_scroller’s six register differences; another order task can lose accidental matches while predecessor code differs.
mechanisms.scope: GCC 4.4.1 full-CU source order; no per-function linker placement.
mechanisms.diagnostic: Whole-CU historical-order overlay with body and exact-neighbor preservation checks.

mechanisms.statement: Changing earlier definitions can change an unchanged downstream target body in GCC 4.4.1 diagnostic full-CU probes.
mechanisms.symptom: Register/instruction residue persists after local body hypotheses converge, while a target body is textually unchanged.
mechanisms.discriminating_experiment: Reproduce a full-CU baseline hash, then omit one explicit predecessor or vary one type/flag and compare target bytes and protected neighbors.
mechanisms.negative_alternatives: HTTPFetchInternal peer/type alternatives and draw_scroller init/scheduling/unit-at-a-time trials did not repair their target residue; one trial caused collateral regressions.
mechanisms.causal_status: effect_observed; internal cause is a WORKING_HYPOTHESIS
mechanisms.cause_hypothesis: GCC i386 peephole2 scratch-register search state retained across successful allocations; compatible with dumps and upstream source, not isolated by the probe.
mechanisms.scope: Observed for HTTPFetchInternal and draw_scroller; neither the observed dependency nor the causal hypothesis is a universal register-mismatch attribution.
mechanisms.diagnostic: Baseline-hash full-CU peer omission/type/flag overlays, then target and neighbor comparison.

mechanisms.statement: A play source split retained seven calls through 179r.dse2; at 181r.csa one call disappeared and the surviving label gained a use, leaving CFG/liveness/context rather than spelling as the next hypothesis.
mechanisms.symptom: Original/candidate call multiplicity differs after source duplication, and local spelling variants are no longer informative.
mechanisms.discriminating_experiment: Compile the production-equivalent TU with diagnostic dumps; compare GIMPLE/RTL around both arms to locate the first observed convergence stage.
mechanisms.negative_alternatives: Explicit duplicated non-guest hint arms still emit six final calls; a more precise optimizer-subpass cause and the historical non-merging distinction are not established.
mechanisms.causal_status: pass-stage observation; common-tail explanation is supported but exact internal subpass is not identified
mechanisms.scope: GCC 4.4.1 diagnostic dump result, not matching proof or generic pass behavior.
mechanisms.diagnostic: Locate first divergent/convergent normalized compiler pass after source variants stop separating.

mechanisms.statement: Keep resolved body proof, relocation/owner proof, same-CU layout, and collateral exact-neighbor preservation as separate acceptance dimensions.
mechanisms.symptom: A body is byte-equal under resolved relocations but layout operands, ownership, or neighboring contributions remain unresolved or differ.
mechanisms.discriminating_experiment: Run before/after contribution and protected-neighbor comparison, then require the explicit layout-blocked claim only when its narrow proof contract holds.
mechanisms.negative_alternatives: Masked equality, size proximity, link closure, or a scope change that reorders BSS/text do not establish the needed proof level.
mechanisms.scope: The terminology and implementation are project-specific; separation of evidence is portable process advice.
mechanisms.diagnostic: Before/after contribution plus protected-neighbor comparison; require explicit layout proof for a layout-blocked body.
